EC2: Women with breast implants on the same side as the lesion
EC3: Women that underwent local radiation [OR] or chemotherapy within the last 12 months
EC4: Women with history of breast cancer [OR] or breast surgery in the same quadrant
EC5: Lesions in or close to scar tissue (< 1cm)
EC6: Skin lesions [OR] or lesions that have been biopsied previously
EC7: Lesion [AND] larger than 4 cm in the longest dimension
EC8: No lesion [AND] should be included when more than 50% of the lesion is further down than 4 cm beneath the skin level.
